name: AutoNav
description: Automates nav mesh generation in-game: launches the game, loads the map, runs nav_generate, and writes the .nav beside the .bsp. Does not support Left 4 Dead 1-2.

inputs.description: The compiled map to generate a nav mesh for. Feeds the positional argument and gates scheduling, so run it after the BSP has been copied into the game's maps folder.

outputs.description: The generated .nav navigation mesh, written into the game's maps folder next to the .bsp.

arguments.name: BSP
arguments.description: The compiled map to generate a nav mesh for, fed by the BSP input edge. Must sit under the selected game's maps folder, since the game is told to load it by name.

arguments.name: Game Executable
arguments.description: Path to the game .exe used to launch the map.

arguments.name: Game Directory
arguments.description: The mod folder to load; the folder containing the maps/ directory.

arguments.name: Console Mode
arguments.description: How console commands reach the game. "exec" relaunches it with -hijack +exec and is the default; "rcon" talks over the network and needs a listen server; "auto" picks by what the game supports. Stated rather than detected, so a run behaves the same every time.
arguments.warning: A game that cannot be hijacked needs rcon or auto.

arguments.name: Steam Executable
arguments.description: Path to steam.exe, for games that must be launched through Steam. Use together with Steam App ID.

arguments.name: Steam App ID
arguments.description: The Steam App ID to launch. Only used together with Steam Executable.
